description: Pulls one client's complete Quo (OpenPhone) text and call history into Sergio through the shared ingest, for a person whose last text predates the connected backfill, as Import older Quo history does. Read-only against Quo; nothing is sent or changed at Quo, and ingest dedups by the Quo id so a repeat brings nothing new. Quo must be connected. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: import_client_quo_history
title: Import a client's older Quo history
